reviewNotes: Twenty-five watering-can, language-name, whimsical random-sentence, and equipment-label strings were translated directly from English. Two full editorial audits cover established tool terminology, language names, surreal sentence imagery, Romanian agreement and tense, title-style capitalization, punctuation, and natural interface wording; both found no remaining objective issue.

WateringCan_enchant.source: In your hands, this can will never run out of water.
WateringCan_enchant.translation: În mâinile tale, această stropitoare nu va rămâne niciodată fără apă.

RandomSentence.1.source: The Purple Dragon danced with the Robot
RandomSentence.1.translation: Dragonul Purpuriu a dansat cu Robotul

RandomSentence.2.source: The Gooey Buffet spoke atop the Castle
RandomSentence.2.translation: Bufetul Lipicios a vorbit deasupra Castelului

RandomSentence.3.source: The Chalky Biscuit cracked way above the Planet
RandomSentence.3.translation: Biscuitul Cretos s-a crăpat mult deasupra Planetei

RandomSentence.4.source: The Green Pepper grilled alongside the Cheese
RandomSentence.4.translation: Ardeiul Verde s-a fript alături de Brânză

RandomSentence.5.source: The Chunky Raincoat smelled dangerously close to the Shoe
RandomSentence.5.translation: Pelerina de Ploaie Voluminoasă mirosea periculos de aproape de Pantof

RandomSentence.6.source: The Gigantic Submarine floated uncomfortably close to the Mermaid
RandomSentence.6.translation: Submarinul Gigantic plutea incomod de aproape de Sirenă

RandomSentence.7.source: The Greasy Hyena stood too close to the other Hyena
RandomSentence.7.translation: Hiena Unsuroasă stătea prea aproape de cealaltă Hienă

RandomSentence.8.source: The Gloomy Elf danced atop the Tomb
RandomSentence.8.translation: Spiridușul Posomorât a dansat pe Mormânt

RandomSentence.9.source: The Crusty Lip cracked way above the Biscuit
RandomSentence.9.translation: Buza cu Crustă s-a crăpat mult deasupra Biscuitului

RandomSentence.10.source: The Rubbery Elf swam near the Disaster
RandomSentence.10.translation: Spiridușul Cauciucat a înotat lângă Dezastru

RandomSentence.11.source: The Courageous Quail grilled far, far away from the other Quail
RandomSentence.11.translation: Prepelița Curajoasă s-a fript foarte, foarte departe de cealaltă Prepeliță

RandomSentence.12.source: The Reasonable Hyena spoke with the Shoe
RandomSentence.12.translation: Hiena Rezonabilă a vorbit cu Pantoful

RandomSentence.13.source: The Practical Submarine cracked miles below the Mermaid
RandomSentence.13.translation: Submarinul Practic s-a crăpat la kilometri sub Sirenă

RandomSentence.14.source: The Lonely Puppet ran far, far away from the Planet
RandomSentence.14.translation: Marioneta Singuratică a fugit foarte, foarte departe de Planetă
